name: justintube-processing
description: Processing container providing yt-dlp downloads and ffmpeg transcoding for Justintube
author: Justin Tavares

scripts.dev: docker build -t justintube-processing . && docker run --rm --env-file=.env -p 3001:3001 -e MEDIA_STORAGE_DIRECTORY=/media -e REDIS_HOST=host.docker.internal -e REDIS_PORT=6379 -p 6379:6379 -v "%cd%/media:/media" --name justintube-processing justintube-processing
